status: exact Minkowski quadratic spin-parity witness for the minimal parity-even first-order 0-minus Poincare-gauge torsion sector

literatureClass.description: independent coframe and Lorentz connection with terms at most quadratic in torsion and curvature
literatureClass.selectedMode: massive spin-parity 0-minus carried by the longitudinal axial torsion
literatureClass.reason: X^2 is parity even, vanishes in the torsionless Riemannian sector, and supplies a derivative only to the axial longitudinal block; this is the smallest tractable propagating-torsion completion
literatureClass.excluded: fakeon, Lee-Wick and nonlocal prescriptions; general six-spin-parity Poincare-gauge parameter space

spin23BrokenAction.pseudoscalarNormalization: Xhat is the rescaled pseudoscalar curvature chosen so that Xhat^(1)=partial_mu S^mu around the torsionless Minkowski vacuum
spin23BrokenAction.geometricOrigin: Xhat is proportional to epsilon^{mu nu rho sigma}R_{mu nu rho sigma}(omega); its square is parity even and is an allowed curvature-squared invariant of the independent connection
spin23BrokenAction.axialTorsion: S^mu=epsilon^{alpha beta gamma mu}T_{alpha beta gamma}
spin23BrokenAction.spin23Mapping: omega^{ab}=A^{ab}; e^a=ell A^{a4}; the invariant is added after V^A selects Spin(1,3) inside Spin(2,3)

quadraticReduction.einsteinCartanAxialCoefficient: R(omega) contains +(1/24)S_mu S^mu modulo a boundary
quadraticReduction.torsionNormAxialCoefficient: T_{mu nu rho}T^{mu nu rho} contains -(1/6)S_mu S^mu
quadraticReduction.otherBlocks: trace and tensor torsion remain algebraic as in claim 1596 and must be nondegenerate before this reduction
quadraticReduction.metricSector: Xhat vanishes for a torsionless Levi-Civita connection by the first Bianchi identity, so Xhat^2 adds no metric spin-2 pole at quadratic order

spinParityProjectorWitness.projectors: P_L^{mu nu}=p^mu p^nu/p^2 and P_T^{mu nu}=eta^{mu nu}-P_L^{mu nu}
spinParityProjectorWitness.euclideanKernel: K^{mu nu}=a_S P_T^{mu nu}+(a_S+b_X p^2)P_L^{mu nu}
spinParityProjectorWitness.transverseDecision: P_T has no momentum-dependent denominator and carries no particle pole
spinParityProjectorWitness.longitudinalPole: p^2=-a_S/b_X, which continues to Minkowski mass squared m_0minus^2=a_S/b_X
spinParityProjectorWitness.residueDecision: the auxiliary dual shows that the canonically normalized longitudinal pole has positive residue exactly when a_S>0

conditions: M_Pl^2>0 for the massless graviton residue
a_S>0, equivalently lambda<1/4, for positive 0-minus kinetic residue
b_X>0 for positive m_0minus^2 once a_S>0
lambda!=-1/2 so the 16-component tensor-torsion algebraic block from claim 1596 is invertible
the trace degeneracy lambda=2 lies outside lambda<1/4 but remains a boundary of the parent action
healthRegion.decision: a genuinely propagating, positive-residue, positive-mass torsion mode coexists with the ordinary massless graviton on a nonempty open coupling region

failureRegions.result: a_S<0 and the canonical 0-minus kinetic term has the ghost sign
the axial algebraic block inherited from claim 1596 vanishes; the auxiliary dual is singular and the mode is not admitted without a separate nonlinear constraint analysis
the unrelated 16-component tensor-torsion block is degenerate, so the claimed one-mode truncation is not isolated
the new pole decouples and axial torsion returns to an algebraic auxiliary field

interpretation.success: unlike the reduced action of claim 1599, this independent-connection curvature square genuinely differentiates a torsion component and realizes a sector-selective torsion gap
interpretation.limits: the result is a quadratic Minkowski admission witness for the isolated 0-minus subclass, not a proof of nonlinear global stability, radiative closure, AdS stability or quantum unitarity
interpretation.lenseThirring: the massless 2-plus pole is unchanged at quadratic order; the new pseudoscalar does not replace the long-range gravitomagnetic graviton

exhaustionAndStopRules: ADMIT the isolated 0-minus pole only for M_Pl^2>0, lambda<1/4, b_X>0 and lambda!=-1/2
REJECT lambda>1/4 as a ghost and b_X<0 in the positive-residue region as a tachyon
STOP at lambda=1/4 and lambda=-1/2 for a full nonlinear Dirac-constraint analysis
DO NOT count the algebraic transverse components of S_mu as three additional particles; only partial.S propagates
DO NOT infer health of the other spin-parity sectors when further curvature invariants are switched on
REPEAT on the Spin(2,3) AdS vacuum and test the appropriate stability bound before claiming background-independent viability
CHECK nonlinear constraint bifurcation and characteristic cones before promoting the quadratic witness to a complete theory
CHECK radiative closure: loops can populate curvature invariants that reactivate ghostly sectors
decision: The tractable first-order subclass succeeds at the quadratic gate: it contains a nonempty healthy region with one gapped 0-minus torsion mode and the massless graviton. This is the first explicit realization of the sector-selective pattern requested in claim 1591, but it remains a candidate action rather than a completed quantum gravity theory.
